label: Bible Study
prompt: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private _____.
verse: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.
note: Peter on scripture — it didn't start with any prophet's private ideas.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And I will _____ among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.
verse: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.
note: Even Leviticus has a love line: I will walk among you — God strolling with His people, like Eden all over again.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the _____ of Beth-lehem, which is by the gate!
verse: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Beth-lehem, which is by the gate!
note: David longed aloud for Bethlehem's well water; three mighty men fetched it — and he poured it out to the LORD.

label: Deep Water
prompt: O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our _____ are upon thee.
verse: O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes are upon thee.
note: King Jehoshaphat, facing three armies, prays the most honest prayer: we don't know what to do — we're looking at you.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and _____ of the Lord.
verse: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
note: Fathers, don't provoke your children to wrath; raise them 'in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.'
